[EN] Are you heading for the Ebon Tower? I know I can't be much help to you, but I will be praying for your safe return. Please come back safely.
[ES] ¿Te diriges a Ebon Tower? Sé que no puedo ser de mucha ayuda, pero estaré rezando por tu regreso a salvo. Por favor, regresa sano y salvo.

[EN] You entered the Ebon Tower and defeated Thulsa, who ran, leaving a trail of blood behind him. Kelsaik was nowhere to be seen...
[ES] Entraste a Ebon Tower y derrotaste a Thulsa, quien huyó dejando un rastro de sangre tras de sí. Kelsaik no aparecía por ningún lado...

[EN] The teleportal in the Ebon Tower won't work no matter what you do. There's only one key that works, and it's...

...Killian's gem? You have it? And you're going in? Here's what we know; it's not much. There are five levels in the tower, and everything is toxic, thanks to Thulsa. Don't forget to use that purification totem.

But we have faith that you will defeat all threats inside—especially Thulsa!
[ES] El teleportal en Ebon Tower no funcionará hagas lo que hagas. Solo hay una llave que funciona, y es...

...¿la gema de Killian? ¿La tienes? ¿Y vas a entrar? Esto es lo que sabemos, que no es mucho. Hay cinco niveles en la torre y todo es tóxico gracias a Thulsa. No olvides usar ese tótem de purificación.

¡Pero tenemos fe en que derrotarás a todas las amenazas del interior, especialmente a Thulsa!

[EN] You have activated the teleportal using Killian's gem. A portal to the Ebon Tower is opening.
[ES] Has activado el teleportal usando la gema de Killian. Se está abriendo un portal a Ebon Tower.

[EN] It's time to use Killian's gem.
[ES] Es hora de usar la gema de Killian.

[EN] You have investigated the teleportal in the Ebon Tower. Traces of Thulsa's magic sustain it, and it vibrates in resonance with another teleportal nearby...over there!
[ES] Has investigado el teleportal en Ebon Tower. Los rastros de la magia de Thulsa lo sostienen, y vibra en resonancia con otro teleportal cercano... ¡por allí!
